Young games with leaderboards hold lower Top Trending positions among games of similar age
Descriptions that ask players to join the group go with lower Up-and-Coming positions among games of the same age

Remove-one-big-object job games (dig out a lawn rock, cut a rock, melt everything) with a rotating list of jobs reach Top Earning and Most Popular, unlike finite clear-the-whole-place chores that settle low on Up-and-Coming
new.action: Rotate fresh jobs every few minutes
new.rationale: Today Rock In My Lawn (21 days, 97% likes, 'new job every few minutes') entered Top Earning and Cut a Rock rose 15 on Most Popular at 58 days, while one-map chores profiled today (Break And Hide The Plane, Melt Everything With Acid, Clean The Bugs) entered Up-and-Coming in its lower half. Confirm if Rock In My Lawn or Cut a Rock still hold Top Earning or Most Popular on 2026-11-25 while at least two finite chore games leave Up-and-Coming; refute if the rotating-job games fall off as fast as the finite ones.

qualitative_updates.note: The wave keeps feeding all four charts but now rotates to its newest members: Ragdoll Realism (15 days) entered Most Popular and rose 79 on Top Earning, Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (13 days) leads Top Trending momentum and Bloody Ragdoll Physics leads Up-and-Coming, while Ragdoll Physics left Up-and-Coming and Ragdoll Physics 2 fell 31 there and 16 on Top Trending; H-uc-036 (physics sandboxes rank higher) fell from 71% to 42%.

Steal mechanics sit lowest on Up-and-Coming within age (r=-0.53) and Build A Steal An Egg is its weakest game; Fake an Egg fell 17 on Most Popular and Hide to Steal Eggs 38 on Top Earning, while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular and Steal A Plane entered Top Earning.

DONT SWIM (17 days) rose 23 on Most Popular and 65 on Top Earning, and Bobby's Daycare, a noise-sensing co-op horror game, entered Up-and-Coming; Do Not Stop. holds the top group on both breakout charts.

The four games still carrying a pumpkin tag on Top Earning all slipped (Tower Defense X -6, Anime Dimensions -8, Flag Wars -15, Flee the Facility -10) and Blox Fruits left Top Trending; Violence District rose 17 on Most Popular on a WEEK 3 event and Jurassic Blocky rose 80 on a second Halloween part, the follow-up exception the hypothesis allows.

Against the claim, Be a Soccer Legend (+20) and Skate Tree (+16) rose on Most Popular today; in favour, sports loops still sit at the 30th median Most Popular percentile and Soccer is the weakest keyword there (r=-0.28), while Ragdoll Soccer rose 41 on Up-and-Coming.
Run a Christmas Tree Lot rose 51 places on Top Earning (386 to 335) at 7 days, but no second Christmas or winter-tagged game is on any chart yet.
Cook Pizzas [Anomaly] rose 42 on Up-and-Coming at 19 days while Animal Hospital (Anomaly) fell 16 on Most Popular at 185 days; the format keeps producing entries but older members drift.
